Privacy policy

Google account and file access

Spendwell uses Google to confirm your account and read your account identifier, name, and email address. It uses per-file access to create a household ledger or open a ledger you select using Google Picker. Google access tokens are kept in browser memory for the active session.

Household data

Transactions, notes, budgets, and the names of people who record transactions are stored in a Google Sheet in the household owner’s Drive. People granted access to that sheet can see its ledger data. When the owner enters an email address to invite someone, Google uses it to grant access and send the invitation.

The site is hosted by GitHub Pages. Spendwell sends ledger data directly from your browser to Google APIs. Your browser keeps a local copy of your account profile, household data, and edits awaiting sync.

Your controls

A household owner can manage or remove a member’s access in Google Drive. Members can retain copies that were already downloaded. Clear this site’s browser data to remove your device’s copy. Sync any pending changes first. To revoke the app’s Google access, use Google Account connections. To remove a household’s cloud ledger, its owner can delete the Google Sheet in Drive.
